format: GLB 2.0, metres, Y up, front +Z, identity node, pivot at the bottom centre
integration: Plain finishes are COLOR_0 (linear). Textured parts sample bedroom_textiles.png, tinted by COLOR_0.

bedroom_textiles.png is a 512 px atlas of four quadrants: denim (top left), knit (top right, near white: the tint is the yarn colour), pale oak (bottom left), wicker (bottom right). UVs stay inside their quadrant, no repeat.
Shared materials: 'Bedroom textiles' (the atlas), 'Bedroom matte', 'Bedroom glaze', 'Bedroom brass', and the two sided 'Pleated shade'.
Floor items are visual only: no collider, no occluder, no NavMesh source.

textures.bedroom_textiles.png: Procedural (numpy): denim twill, V-stitch knit, pale oak grain, wicker basket weave.
